weighmaster.sight: A set of scales the size of a cart, and something sitting in the pan that is doing the weighing itself.
weighmaster.line: It has been short-changing this parish for four hundred years.
speaker: maret
corvin
weighmaster.cleared: The pans hang level. They have not hung level in living memory.

motherbrine.sight: The pan has not filled since the works closed. Something down there is drinking it.
motherbrine.line: That is a lot of salt for one thing to be made of.
speaker: osric
bastian

theannealer.sight: The kiln is still hot. Nobody has fed it in sixty years.
theannealer.line: It is finishing the last firing. It does not know the shift ended.
speaker: aurelian
maret

theeleventhhour.sight: The clock in the tower has been striking eleven for as long as anyone here has been alive.
theeleventhhour.line: It is going to want to strike twelve eventually.
speaker: kestrel
wick

thelonghand.sight: Something came off the clock face and did not stop moving.
thelonghand.line: Mind the sweep. It only goes one way, but it goes the whole way.
speaker: oda
corvin

thelatebell.sight: The bell is rung. The sound arrives some time afterwards, and not always in the same place.
thelatebell.line: I have heard it twice already and it has not been struck yet.
speaker: ilsabet
wick

thefirstrank.sight: A rank of them, dressed and standing, and none of them has been relieved.
thefirstrank.line: They are waiting for the order. I am not going to give it.
speaker: rusk
maret

bannerofthenine.sight: The banner is still up. Whatever is holding it has been holding it a long time.
bannerofthenine.line: Nine lanterns on it. Somebody kept the count and somebody kept the cloth.
speaker: wick
maret

vergemarshal.sight: It has a gorget, a sash, and a commission signed by an office that no longer exists.
vergemarshal.line: I countersigned one of those. Not this one.
speaker: maret
aurelian

thelongdrift.sight: The drift has been moving across the shelf all afternoon, against the wind.
speaker: bastian
tam

themotherlode.sight: The seam runs out into the dark and then, some distance in, it turns to look at you.
themotherlode.line: That is the ore. That is all of the ore.
speaker: bastian
aurelian

thegreatthirst.sight: There is a well here and it is dry, and the ground around it for forty paces is dry too.
thegreatthirst.line: It is not empty. It is still drinking.
speaker: tam
osric

thetithe.sight: A collection box, bolted down, with four hundred years of takings still in it and something sitting on top.
thetithe.line: It is owed. It is very clear about being owed.
speaker: corvin
maret

theopenhand.sight: The almshouse is still serving. The queue is long and none of it is breathing.
theopenhand.line: Do not take anything. Not one thing.
speaker: wick
ilsabet

whatremains.sight: Whatever this was, most of it has gone. What is left has had to take on the whole job.
whatremains.line: It is doing the work of nine things with the parts of one.
speaker: aurelian
kestrel

theunwinding.sight: It is coming apart, and it has been coming apart for a very long time, and it is not finished.
speaker: vesna
idris
